data.situation:
The conservatory was warmer than the path outside. Maya leaned over a seed tray without touching it. Some seeds had begun to germinate; thin shoots stood above the soil. Ruth had recorded the date of germination on each label. Beside the tray, an empty pot waited for a young plant. She would replant it in a larger pot once it was ready. The plants would thrive only if their needs were met, not simply because they were indoors. Maya: Has every seed germinated?
Ruth: Not yet. Look at the dates; these were planted later.
Jo: When will you replant this one?
Ruth: When it has grown enough for the next pot. We check it rather than follow a date alone.

readingBlocks.zh: 玻璃种植房比外面小径暖和。玛雅俯身看种子托盘，没有触碰。有些种子已开始发芽，细芽露出土面。露丝在标签上记录发芽日期。旁边空盆等着一株幼苗，等它长好后换种进大盆。植物要满足生长需要才会茁壮，并非进室内就能长好。

readingBlocks.en:
Maya: Has every seed germinated?
Ruth: Not yet. Look at the dates; these were planted later.

Ruth: When it has grown enough for the next pot. We check it rather than follow a date alone.
readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅：每颗种子都发芽了吗？
露丝：还没有。看看日期，这些种得晚。
乔：何时重新种这株？
露丝：等它长到适合下一个盆时。我们看植株情况，不只看日期。

glossary.zh: 带玻璃墙和屋顶、可供植物生长的房间

externalEvidence.definition: a greenhouse in which plants are arranged in a pleasing manner

glossary.note: a seed / seeds；并非所有植物都用种子繁殖。
glossary.example: Maya examined a seed in the tray.
glossary.exampleZh: 玛雅观察托盘里一颗种子。

externalEvidence.definition: a mature fertilized plant ovule consisting of an embryo and its food source and having a protective coat or testa

glossary.note: 本例不及物；及物促使发芽等未计。
glossary.example: Some seeds had begun to germinate.

glossary.note: 过程名词；不是发芽后的整株幼苗。
glossary.example: Ruth recorded the date of germination.

externalEvidence.definition: the process whereby seeds or spores sprout and begin to grow

glossary.note: replant a plant/tree；本例移入另一盆。
glossary.example: She will replant it in a larger pot.
glossary.exampleZh: 她会把它重新种进大盆。

glossary.note: 本例植物；商业发展用法未计。

glossary.exampleZh: 满足需要时植物茁壮生长。
